scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: rm -rf dist-chrome && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist-chrome && cp manifest.chrome.json dist-chrome/manifest.json && cp popup.html dist-chrome/
scripts.build:firefox: rm -rf dist-firefox && tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist-firefox && cp manifest.firefox.json dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp popup.html dist-firefox/
